entries.description: A 40-acre farm owned and operated by one lesbian, raising animals with a garden and camping space, open to visitors with overnight fees and welcoming children, non-lesbian women, and known males.
entries.raw_text: JAN F WALSH Two Towers, 201 S 132nd Ave, Shelby, MI 49455 (616)861-4939. I own a farm, live on it and work it somewhat. I raise animals and have a . 1 acre garden. I welcome visitors, especially lesbians as I am quite isolated, but I do not forbid males of any age access IF known to me or with wimmin. There is camping space galore. If the visit is over 1 night I ask for a $2 fee (I trade)/night per person to defray my costs (water, toilet paper, produce, etc). Drugs in moderation are fine. No proselytizing please. Extended visits (over 1 week) need to be decided in person. I welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, (males). I have/am: 1 lesbian, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing (cold running water only)/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because it is owned and lived on by one woman ('I own a farm, live on it'). Street address is the land address. Num_residents is 1 based on 'I have/am: 1 lesbian' living on the farm. Accepted groups includes Gay men and Non-gay men with condition noted ('(males)' IF known or with wimmin). Focus on Farming/self-sufficiency from 'I own a farm, live on it and work it somewhat. I raise animals and have a . 1 acre garden.' Drugs in moderation are fine, so not recovery/substance-free.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in West Central Wisconsin; half wooded campground, half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc; farm land
entries.description: An 80-acre women's land cooperative farm with campground, hayfield, orchard, and garden in West Central Wisconsin, where four women live year-round, offering camping with chemical-free space and welcoming new members, girl children, toddler boys up to age 2, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: WISCONSIN WOMYN'S LAND CO-OP Rt 2 Box 42, Norwalk, WI 54648 (608)269-5301. WWLC owns DOE (Daughters of Earth) Farm; half wooded campground, half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc in West Central Wisconsin. The land is hilly, secluded, very beautiful. Four womyn live here year 'round, more in summer. Some of the campground chemical free space. Camping equipment available if needed. Sliding scale fees. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children 'til age of 2, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 175 members almost all lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on co-op ownership and residential collective ('Four womyn live here year 'round'). Rural route address is the land address. Num_residents is 4 ('Four womyn live here year 'round'). Accepted groups: Boy children with restriction ('boy children 'til age of 2'). Focus Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'chemical free space'. Focus Farming/self-sufficiency from 'half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc'.

entries.description: An 80-acre land space lived on by two lesbians creating lesbian reality and harmony with nature, offering primitive camping and welcoming girl and boy children by arrangement and differently abled women; chemically free with no men, pets, or guns.
entries.raw_text: THE WEB c/o Lanning, Box 8742, Minneapolis, MN 55408 (612)983-2289. We are consciously creating a space in which to live our lesbian reality in harmony with the natural world. Primitive camping here is open to wimmin. We hope to build a community focused on interdependent care toward the healing and health of us all. Chemically free, no pets, no guns, no men. We welcome: girl and boy children by arrangement, differently abled. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/ electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land by the two-woman rule ('We have/are: 2 lesbians... women living on the land'); they hope to build community but do not explicitly recruit new residential members on the welcome list. Contact is a PO Box in Minneapolis so land street/zip are blank; land state assumed MN. Num_residents is 2 based on '2 lesbians' and 'women living on the land'. Focus Disabled women from welcoming 'differently abled' and focusing on 'interdependent care toward the healing and health of us all'. Focus Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'Chemically free'.

entries.description: A 40-acre vacation ranch in Montana run by two resident lesbians, offering tipi lodgings, camping, food service, hot tub, and sports facilities as a holiday alternative for lesbians and gay men, with women-only weeks.
entries.raw_text: NORTH CROW VACATION RANCH RR 1, Box 62-A, Ronan, MT 59864 (406)676-5169. A new social alternative for lesbians and gay men on holiday. Tipi lodgings ($11/night) or campsite ($7/night). Some weeks are for womyn only. We provide food service ($11/night), hot tub, sports facilities, firewood and basic conveniences. Close by: swimming, boating, etc. Reservations preferred. We welcome: girl and boy children, gay males. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is defined as a vacation ranch for visitors on holiday. Rural route address is the land address. Num_residents is 2 ('2 lesbians', 'women living and working on the land'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children, Gay men ('gay males').

entries.land_location_as_stated: combination of woods, meadows, and rocky bluffs; a creek and springs; camping space, woods
entries.description: A group of four lesbians with 90 acres of woods, meadows, rocky bluffs, creek, and springs, planning personal cabins, camping, and farming with an emphasis on solar and appropriate technology and nurturing the female principle; seeking new members.
entries.raw_text: REBECCA, SUSAN, ANNE & MAURINE 4026 Anderson SE, Albuquerque, NM 87108 (505)268-1863. The land is a combination of woods, meadows, and rocky bluffs. We have a creek and springs. Long-term plans include: cabins for our personal use, additional cabins and camping sites for use by visiting women (by pre-arrangement only), and some farming. Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology and on developing a place that nurtures the female principle. We welcome: new members/resident. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 90 acres, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: Community name taken from the opening names. Contact address is in Albuquerque while cabins are only 'long-term plans', indicating they do not live on the land yet; land street/city/zip left blank, land state NM inferred. Num_residents is 0 because cabins are in long-term plans ('cabins for our personal use'). Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as 4 women own the land and recruit new members/residents. Focus Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology'. Focus Spirituality/ritual from 'nurtures the female principle'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: 2 hours north of SF; woods and meadows, farm land (grazing)
entries.description: A 167-acre collective land project two hours north of San Francisco seeking two lesbian-feminists to form a new group to purchase out the old group, into building living space, relationship, and feminism, with a rule against drug abuse.
entries.raw_text: YORKVILLE WOMEN'S LAND COLLECTIVE c/o Annie, 50 Balmy, San Francisco, CA 94110 (415)285-5145. YWLC seeking 2 lesbian-feminists for new group. Old group (save one) needs to sell. Lots of land 2 hours north of SF. Needs committment, money and respect. Into building living space, relationship, feminism. Not into drug abuse or S&M. Send name, address and phone for full details. Issues & money still negotiable. We welcome: new members, loans. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 167 acres, camping space, woods and meadows, farm land (grazing).
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('COLLECTIVE', seeking members for new group). Contact address is in SF, while land is '2 hours north of SF' and name specifies Yorkville; land_city set to Yorkville, CA based on community name. Num_residents is left blank because 'We have/are: 6 lesbians' does not state they live on the land (and 'Old group (save one) needs to sell'). Focus Recovery/substance-free from 'Not into drug abuse'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: near Russian River; creek on land; woods, farm land
entries.description: A 500-acre privately woman-owned property near the Russian River open June through September for camping and events, boarding horses, with housing limited to workers, welcoming non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children under 10.
entries.raw_text: THE RANCH c/o Helen Wagner, 440 Holladay, San Francisco, CA 94110 (415)824-5352. Privately Woman owned land open to camping and events June-Sept. Horses boarded, workers welcomed. Daily and weekly rates and special event rates $5/day and up. We welcome: new members, girl children, boy children under 10, nonlesbian women, dogs, horses. We have/are: 500 acres, housing/permanent structures limited to workers, plumbing, outhouses, camping space, woods, farm land, cook out grills, creek on land, near Russian River, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land ('Privately Woman owned land'). Mailing address is in SF, land is 'near Russian River' in CA; land street/city/zip left blank. Num_residents left blank because no count of resident women is given ('women living and working on the land' has no number). Accepted groups: Boy children with restriction ('boy children under 10').

entries.land_location_as_stated: close to the ocean; 160 acres of redwood-covered slopes, open grassy meadows, waterfalls, and pools for reflection; woods, farm land
entries.description: A 60-acre women's community and retreat on Greenwood Road in Elk, California, with 10 structures, gardens, and orchard, originally an older women's community and now seeking permanent members, especially lesbians over 50, with sliding fees for working-class, older, and women of color.
entries.raw_text: LAVENDER HILL 1085 Greenwood Rd, Elk, AC 95432. A thriving womyn's community and retreat located 3 hours north of SF and close to the ocean. 160 acres of redwood-covered slopes, open grassy meadows, waterfalls, and pools for reflection. Nine structures including a communal kitchen, guesthouse, and bath house, look out over surrounding valleys and hills. A vegetable and flower garden, an herb garden, and an orchard. We began as an older womyn's community. We are now womyn of diverse ages, races and backgrounds, looking for permanent members (especially lesbians over 50). Visitors $5/night (exceptions: working class/older/third world women). We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women (possibly). We have/are: 8 lesbians, 60 acres, 10 housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity with generator, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: State typo 'AC' corrected to 'CA'. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('community and retreat', community named first, actively seeking permanent members). Road address is the land address. Acreage is stored as 60 following the rule to record the smaller of two numbers (text mentions 160 acres, questionnaire says 60 acres). Num_residents is 8 ('8 lesbians', 'women living and working on the land'). Focus Older women from 'began as an older womyn's community... looking for permanent members (especially lesbians over 50)'. Focus Working-class women from visitor fee exemptions for 'working class... women'. Focus Farming/self-sufficiency from gardens, orchard, and farm land.
